transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been going on that brought you in today?

Well, um, thank you for seeing me. I... I hope it's okay that I'm here. My husband's doctor suggested I come in. It's just... well, people keep acting like I'm making things up, or maybe that I'm just stressed from work. I clean houses, you see, and I try to do a really good job. But... I know the hospital people, and maybe some folks from my cleaning agency, they've been... well, keeping an eye on our house. And my cleaning routes. I think they just want to make sure I'm taking proper care of my husband, which I am, I promise. I just... I know they're watching, even if others say they aren't. Does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining it right.
Do you believe that people are monitoring or keeping track of your actions, such as following you or watching your house?

Well, um... yes, I do. I mean, I hope it doesn't sound like I'm complaining, because I know they probably just mean well. But... yes. I've noticed people from the hospital, and maybe some of the supervisors from my cleaning agency, keeping tabs on me. They watch the house, and I've seen them checking up on my cleaning routes. I think they just want to make absolutely sure I'm doing a good job and taking proper care of my husband since he's been sick. I try so hard to do everything right for him, I really do. But everyone else tells me I'm just imagining it. I'm not crazy for thinking they're watching, am I? I just... I know what I see. Is it okay that I feel that way?
Do you feel that people are not only watching you but also trying to harm you, control your actions, or that events happening around you have a special meaning directed at you?

Oh, no, no, I don't think they want to harm me at all. I hope I didn't make it sound like they're bad people. I... I really just think they're checking up on me. Like I said before, I know the hospital people and some folks from the agency are watching our house and my cleaning routes. But I think they just want to see if I'm taking proper care of my husband. 

They don't control me, and I don't think there are any secret messages or anything like that. It's just... well, they're just keeping an eye on things. And I'm only here because everyone keeps acting like I'm imagining it all. But I wouldn't make something like that up, I promise. I try to be very honest. Does that answer your question okay? I want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Do you ever feel like your thoughts are being put into your mind by someone else, or that your thoughts are being broadcasted so others can hear them?

Oh, my... no, I've never felt anything like that. That sounds very frightening, actually. Um... my thoughts are just my own, I promise. Nobody is putting them there, and nobody can hear them. I... I hope it's okay to say no to that. I just want to be helpful and tell you the truth. I'm just a regular person trying to do my job and take care of my husband, I don't have anything strange like that going on in my head. Is it alright that I don't have that happening? I don't want to disappoint you if you were looking for a different answer.
Have you ever experienced any thoughts or beliefs that might sound unusual or hard to believe, like something out of a movie or a very strange situation?

Oh, um... no. No, nothing like that. I really hope I'm not being difficult, but no, I haven't had anything happen that sounds like a movie or... or anything too strange. 

I mean, just what I told you before, about the people from the hospital and the agency checking on me. I know that sounds a little unusual to some people, which is why they wanted me to come talk to you, but to me, it just feels like they're being thorough, you know? But other than that... no aliens or magic or anything bizarre. I'm just a normal, hardworking person, I promise. I try to be very sensible. Is that... is that the kind of thing you were asking about? I really hope I'm answering these questions the right way for you.
Even though others have told you that you're not being watched, do you still believe that the hospital staff and your supervisors are keeping an eye on you?

Well, yes, I... I do still believe it. I hope that doesn't make me sound stubborn. I really don't want to be difficult, I promise. It's just... I know what I've seen, you know? 

Like I said, I'm only here because everyone keeps acting like I'm imagining the whole thing. My family, the people at work... they all think I'm just making it up. But I wouldn't do that. I know the hospital people and some folks from the agency have been watching our house, and they've been following my cleaning routes. I just know they want to see if I'm taking proper care of my husband. 

I try to explain it to people, but they just get upset with me. I'm sorry if saying that makes me seem unreasonable. I just want to be honest with you. Is it okay that I still feel this way, even if other people don't agree? I really am trying my best to cooperate.
Can you tell me why you believe the hospital staff and your supervisors are watching you, even though they have told you they are not?

Well, um... I guess it's because I just... I see them. I mean, I know they say they aren't, and I really don't want to call anyone a liar, especially not my supervisors. They're good people, they really are. But... I just notice things, you know? 

Like, I'll be on my cleaning route, just doing my job—and I always do a very thorough job, I promise—and I'll see the same car parked near the houses I'm working at. Or I'll see someone from the hospital walking past our house, just sort of lingering. And it's not just once or twice, it's... it's a pattern. 

I know my husband's health is complicated, and I know they want to make sure he's okay. I really think they just want to be sure I'm taking proper care of him. Which I am! I take wonderful care of him. I just... I wish they would believe me instead of checking up on me like this. 

I hope it doesn't make me sound paranoid or crazy to say that. I really don't want you to think badly of me. I'm just trying to explain what I've been seeing. Does... does that make sense? I hope I'm not giving you the wrong impression.
Even though the hospital staff and your supervisors have told you directly that they are not watching you, do you still believe they are, and if so, why can’t you accept their word for it?

Oh, um... well, I really don't want to seem like I'm calling anyone a liar. I know they said they aren't watching me, and I respect them so much. I really do. It's just... I guess I'm here because people keep acting like I'm imagining the whole thing, but I know what I've seen. 

I know the hospital people and some folks from the agency have been watching our house, and they've been following my cleaning routes. I just... I can't just ignore it when I see it happening, you know? They just want to see if I'm taking proper care of my husband, which I understand, I really do. I just wish they would trust me. 

I'm so sorry if that makes me sound difficult or like I'm not listening to them. I really am trying to be cooperative. I just... I can't help what I see with my own eyes. Is it okay that I still feel this way? I really don't want you to be disappointed in me.
Have you ever had any other beliefs or thoughts that others might find strange or hard to believe, even if they’re not related to being watched or followed?

Oh, um... no, I don't think so. I mean, besides what we just talked about with the hospital folks, I really try to just keep my head down and focus on my cleaning and taking care of my husband. I don't have any other... well, unusual ideas or anything like that. I really try to be very sensible, I promise. 

I hope that's an okay answer? I just wouldn't want you to think I'm... well, completely losing my mind or anything. I'm just a regular person who wants to do a good job and do right by my family. I haven't noticed any other strange thoughts, honestly. Is it alright that it's just that one thing? I really am trying my best to give you all the right information.
